{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows
print(penguins.head())

# Check for missing values
print("Missing values:")
print(penguins.isnull().sum())

# Check data types
print(penguins.dtypes)

# Check for duplicates
print(f"Number of duplicate rows: {penguins.duplicated().sum()}")

# Summary statistics for the two variables of interest
print("Summary statistics for flipper_length_mm and body_mass_g:")
print(penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].describe())"}
